answer: Work waits on the jade until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. By the karst of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
